description: This file defines a static utility class 'SyntaxFactoryUtility' providing extension methods for syntax tree manipulation using Roslyn APIs. It includes methods for creating member access expressions, generic names, and adding type parameters with constraints to class declarations.

classes.name: SyntaxFactoryUtility
classes.description: A static internal class providing extension methods for creating and manipulating C# syntax nodes for code generation using Roslyn APIs.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, string)
methods.description: Returns a member access expression for the given instance and member name.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, IdentifierNameSyntax)
methods.description: Creates a member access expression using an IdentifierNameSyntax for the member.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, GenericNameSyntax)
methods.description: Creates a member access expression using a GenericNameSyntax.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, string, params TypeSyntax[])
methods.description: Creates a member access expression with generic type arguments.

methods.name: ToGenericName (string)
methods.description: Converts a string identifier into a GenericNameSyntax.

methods.name: AddGenericTypeParameters
methods.description: Adds generic type parameters and constraints to a class declaration syntax node.

methods.name: GetTypeParameterConstraints
methods.description: Generates a list of constraints for each type parameter based on its symbol.
